# CANDIDATE: ORB_RIBBON_IMBALANCE_RECLAIM

**Filed:** 2026-09-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Opening-range gap with volume surge and bearish EMA ribbon creates a high-probability pullback reclaim. The mechanism identifies false breakouts above the opening range that reverse when institutional volume aligns with a bearish EMA structure, allowing a counter-trend long entry on the pullback to VWAP/10EMA within the ORB.

## Mechanism

At market open, compute the 30-minute opening range (ORB). If the first 5-minute bar gaps above ORB high, volume exceeds 2× the 5-minute average volume, and the EMA ribbon (5,9,21,50) is sloping down (5EMA < 9EMA < 21EMA < 50EMA), wait for price to pull back to VWAP (or 10EMA) within the ORB range. Enter long on the next bar open when a bullish candle closes above VWAP and a higher-low (HH) structure forms on the 5-minute chart. Exit: chart stop below the most recent lower low (LL) of the pullback. Take first target at 1.5R (risk = entry-stop). After TP1, trail 15% off the highest previous trade price (HWM). Regime filter: VIX < 15 and consolidation phase; avoid high-volatility days and major news.
